entries.bad_example: for i in {1..100}; do ./task.sh & done; wait
entries.good_example:
max_jobs=4
for i in {1..100}; do
    (( $(jobs -r | wc -l) >= max_jobs )) && wait -n
    ./task.sh &
done; wait
entries.rationale: Firing too many background processes simultaneously leads to fork bombs and OOM errors. SS QLM requires job limiting (semaphores) for system stability.
Concurrent execution of scripts modifying the same resources causes race conditions. SS QLM standardizes advisory locking via 'flock' to ensure single-instance integrity.
